name: Shanghai Turbo Enterprises Ltd
summary: Shanghai Turbo Enterprises Ltd, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells precision vane products for steam turbine power generator manufacturers in the People's Republic of China. The company offers stationary and moving vanes, and nozzles, which are used as components in steam turbine generators for power generation in power plants, power stations, and substations. It also provides precision vane products related subcontracting services. Shanghai Turbo Enterprises Ltd was founded in 1997 and is based in Changzhou, the People's Republic of China.
